items.title: The Phasmophobia community has raised over $200,000 for a charity event
items.summary: Once again this year, publisher Kinectic Games organized a charity event through its game Phasmophobia to raise funds to support the American Heart Association…
items.content:
Once again this year, publisher Kinectic Games organized a charity event through its game Phasmophobia to raise funds to support the American Heart Association Live, which funds various scientific research projects. More than 500 streamers signed up, marking the highest participation rate yet.

The community once again outdid itself, raising over $200,000 (approximately €179,000) for the association. That’s more than double the amount raised last year.

Tom Dent, Senior Manager of Social Media and Player Experience at Kinetic Games, said:

"The Phasmophobia community never ceases to amaze us, and this year, it really outdid itself. Thank you to all the streamers, viewers, and players who participated."

A reward now awaits all players: an AHA Advocate ID card and animated badge, available to all players who log in before November 15 to claim them.

Congratulations, Ghost Hunters, you've surpassed the community target and raised over $200,000 for our friends at @Heart_Liive ! Your kindness and generosity will not go unrewarded, log in to Phasmophobia before the 15th November to claim the Animated AHA Advocate ID Card &… pic.twitter.com/KFQKaqXNCl

items.title: ‘Phasmophobia’ Community Raises $230K for American Heart Association
items.summary: This week, developer Kinetic Games announced that the community charity event "Ghost Hunts for Hearts" has raised more than $230,000 for the American
items.content:
News PC Virtual Reality Xbox Genghis Husameddin

This week, developer Kinetic Games announced that the community charity event “Ghost Hunts for Hearts” has raised more than $230,000 for the American Heart Association—doubling that of the $100K+ total from last year. The community of ‘Phasmophobia’, a popular cooperative horror title, participated in Ghost Hunts for Hearts ran from 26th October to 2 November 2026, with support from Heart Liive, an American Heart Association initiative that brings together content creators and their communities to raise lifesaving funds and support the organisation’s mission. Over the week, more than 500 streamers signed up to take part, the biggest response Heart Liive has seen for any creator fundraising campaign to date. That’s pretty honking rad.

“The Phasmophobia community never fails to amaze us, and this year they’ve outdone themselves. Doubling last year’s total and seeing more than 500 streamers come together for a cause that matters is incredible. Thank you to every streamer, viewer and player who took part, and to our friends at Heart Liive for helping make it happen,” said Tom Dent , Lead Social Media & Player Experience Manager at Kinetic Games.

This year, Kinetic Games offered a Twitch Drop for Phasmophobia streamers who fundraised for the campaign. From the start of the event, participating fundraising streamers could give viewers the event-exclusive Advocate ID Card and Badge during any Phasmophobia stream throughout the week, rewarding the audiences who tuned in and supported the cause.

Kinetic Games’ fundraising goal was revealed at the start of the event on 20 October as $200,000. As a reward for passing this milestone, the community unlocked an animated version of the Advocate ID Card and Badge set for all Phasmophobia players.

“Ghost Hunts for Hearts shows what’s possible when content creation meets cause,” said Hayli Baez , Senior National Lead for Heart Liive. “We’re grateful to Kinetic Games and every creator, viewer and player who raised lifesaving funds and supported the American Heart Association’s mission to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives.”

Phasmophobia is available in Early Access across PC via Steam , PlayStation 5, PS VR2 , and Xbox Series consoles, priced at 19.99 USD/16.75 GBP/19.50 EURO. We’ve run our own charity livestream, too, of which you can learn about over here !

Enjoying DayOne ? Do us a favour, and make us a ‘ Preferred Source on Google ‘ – that way, you’ll only be delivered more gaming coverage from our team.

There’s plenty of ways to become a part of DayOne. Head over and let us know your thoughts in the Day O ne Forums , the perfect place to chat about games if you’re a little more old-school and prefer things in a longform form, and if you mainly play on PC, join our Steam Community to connect with other members and maybe make some new friends!

Prefer the chaos of live and fast moving conversation? Come and make some noise in the lively DayOne Community Discord Server instead. If you’re rocking a DayOne Membership, both places give special access for our supporters, and you’ll unlock a ton of exclusive content, just for you.

items.title: PHASMOPHOBIA COMMUNITY RAISES OVER $230,000 FOR AMERICAN HEART ASSOCIATION IN RECORD-BREAKING GHOST HUNTS FOR HEARTS CAMPAIGN!
items.summary: The Phasmophobia community has demonstrated that ghost hunting can make a difference beyond the virtual world, raising more than $230,000 for the American Heart Association through the hugely successful Ghost Hunts for Hearts 2026 charity campaign.
items.content:
The Phasmophobia community has demonstrated that ghost hunting can make a difference beyond the virtual world, raising more than $230,000 for the American Heart Association through the hugely successful Ghost Hunts for Hearts 2026 charity campaign.

Developer Kinetic Games has confirmed that this year’s fundraising event more than doubled the $100,000+ raised in 2025, marking another major milestone for the popular cooperative horror game and its dedicated community.

Running from 26 October to 2 November 2026 , the week-long campaign brought together more than 500 streamers , setting a new participation record for a creator fundraising campaign supported by Heart Liive , an American Heart Association initiative.

The event combined livestreamed paranormal investigations, community fundraising and exclusive in-game rewards, encouraging players and viewers worldwide to support an important cause.

This year’s Ghost Hunts for Hearts campaign represented a significant step forward for Kinetic Games and the wider Phasmophobia community.

Organised with support from Heart Liive, the initiative encouraged content creators to turn their ghost-hunting livestreams into fundraising opportunities, allowing audiences to contribute directly to the American Heart Association’s mission of improving cardiovascular health and saving lives.

Throughout the campaign, participating streamers explored Phasmophobia’s haunted environments, investigated supernatural activity and entertained their communities while raising money.

The response exceeded expectations, with over 500 streamers registering to participate.

According to Kinetic Games, this represented the largest number of creators ever involved in a Heart Liive fundraising campaign.

The impressive turnout also highlighted the growing role of gaming communities in charitable fundraising, demonstrating how livestreaming platforms can bring thousands of viewers together around a shared cause.

To celebrate the campaign and encourage participation, Kinetic Games introduced a special Ghost Hunts for Hearts Twitch Drop.

Viewers watching eligible fundraising streams throughout the event could unlock the exclusive Advocate ID Card and Badge, allowing them to show their support for the campaign inside Phasmophobia .

The rewards provided an additional incentive for players to discover participating content creators, engage with the charity initiative and support the fundraising efforts.

However, the developer had another surprise planned.

items.title: Phasmophobia - Development Preview #22
items.summary: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. We want to start this Development Preview, which contains a lot of exciting news for the rest of the year, with a heartfelt thank you to those that have continued to support us throughout this year. The feedback
items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

We want to start this Development Preview, which contains a lot of exciting news for the rest of the year, with a heartfelt thank you to those that have continued to support us throughout this year. The feedback you’ve provided us has helped us shape Phasmophobia in the last few months and in what’s to come. 

After our Roadmap shift earlier in the year, we committed to a more transparent style of communication with you and we intend to stick with that. You can expect to hear much more from us as we work towards Phasmophobia 1.0 in late 2027.

With that said, let's get into the details. With this Development Preview, we’re going to be talking to the following topics:

  • The upcoming Content Update.

    [/*]

  • Phasmophobia’s move to Unity 6.

    [/*]

  • New in-game warnings.

    [/*]

  • Phasmophobia on XBOX Play Anywhere.

    [/*]

  • Player Character Visual Update

    [/*]

  • 42 Edgefield Road Rework.

    [/*]

There’s a lot of information to dig into, so we highly recommend getting settled in with a warm cup of \ and a couple of biscuits.

Firstly;

Introducing the Resonance Update

While we’ve been working on multiple updates over the Summer, one thing became clear - shipping these at different times was looking unreasonable, both for us and you. So instead, we’ve packaged together the Unity 6 update and our Content Update into one. We’re calling this Resonance, and it’ll be launching in late November. 

We’ll dive into more detail on the move to Unity 6 shortly, but let’s talk about some new features coming to Phasmophobia as part of Resonance first.

Up first, the Dowsing Rods.

Icons on the Sensor’s map will reflect the type of sound - a looping sound will stick around for a while whereas a single sound will ping once and disappear. Only sounds on the same floor will be identified by the Sound Sensor. You’ll also be able to use the Sound Sensor’s map as a way of determining a Ghost type based on the speed of movement, which will be especially useful during a Hunt.

As part of this update, we’ll also be introducing a new aspect of Voice Recognition, giving you the chance to instruct the Ghost to interact with nearby objects such as doors and switches and take action such as throwing objects or give a sign of their presence. These options will also be available for players that have their Voice Recognition mode set to Text. For VR players using Text mode, these options will be available via the Sanity watch where they’ll be able to use these commands.

To make sure you can keep track of what’s possible with Voice Recognition, we’re adding the below page to the Journal, listing out the usable phrases - no more shouting into the void in the hope you get it right! 

Finally, before we move on, you’ll now be able to select as many maps as you wish to create your own random map pool. We've also added new buttons to quickly select small, medium and large maps. The fourth icon, the dice, will serve the same purpose as the original Random Map polaroid. And hey, by removing a polaroid from the board, we make room for newer additions. That’s helpful!

Our Transition to Unity 6

For a while now, we’ve been speaking about our move to Unity 6 - the latest version of the engine Phasmophobia runs on. We apologise it’s taken a while to get to this point, but we’re happy to say we’ll be making the leap over to Unity 6 as part of Resonance. 

The biggest part of Unity 6 is focusing on Phasmophobia’s stability, performance and improving the overall experience for Ghost Hunters. It’s also a futureproofing exercise, opening up a lot of potential for the game - especially in the run up to Phasmophobia 1.0 later next year and our plans beyond that point. 

Since we began work on this iteration of the game, a lot of the reported bugs have been fixed within the Unity 6 update of Phasmophobia. With the release of this update in late November, you can expect to see lots - and we do mean lots - of bug fixes, general improvements and more implemented into the game. While we’ll share patch notes on release, a lot of the more common issues we see players encountering will be addressed with this update, including the more common crashes players have been experiencing.

Unity 6 has also given us the ability to improve the lighting across the board in Phasmophobia, to create a much more realistic and immersive experience for Ghost Hunters. While this isn’t an update that’s immediately visible to the naked eye, the video and images below show the difference of what’s now possible.

Alongside the above lighting changes, we’re introducing several new Settings to improve your time with Phasmophobia, ranging from graphical settings presets, an extreme shadow quality setting as well as overall quality presets and Eye Adaptation for VR players. We’re also implementing the following accessibility options for players that experience colour-blindness;

  • Protanopia

    [/*]

  • Protanomaly

    [/*]

  • Deuteranopia

    [/*]

  • Deuteranomaly

    [/*]

  • Tritanopia

    [/*]

  • Tritanomaly

    [/*]

  • Achromatopsia

    [/*]

  • Achromatomaly

    [/*]

As mentioned, the move to Unity 6 aims to greatly improve the overall performance of Phasmophobia for all players across CPU, GPU, VRAM and RAM usage, while also fixing any memory leaks we were seeing. We’re expecting this to be a significant improvement, but one we can only truly gauge when the update is in your hands. Once the update is live, we’ll be closely monitoring any and all feedback to see where we can continue to make improvements, so please do submit any bugs you encounter to our Help Centre so our team can investigate.

New In-Game Warning System

One part of the road to Phasmophobia 1.0 that is important to us is improving the overall player experience in-game. We want to investigate ways for your time spent in-game with others to be more rewarding and meaningful, and vitally, feel like a part of a community.

While we'll share more of our thoughts and ideas at a later stage, one piece of this that we're introducing as part of the Resonance update is a new system in-game that provides player's with a warning message if they have been found to be in violation of our Code of Conduct instead of immediately resulting in a ban - unless of course their actions are severe enough to receive an immediate ban.

We'll also be informing you if a report you have made has resulted in action taken against a player you've reported.

XBOX Play Anywhere

Finally, as part of the Resonance update, we’ll also be introducing Phasmophobia into the XBOX Play Anywhere program. This means that if you own Phasmophobia on XBOX already, you’ll be able to play it across any device that supports XBOX play - PC, laptops, ROG Ally and of course, XBOX Series X/S.

For more details on how the XBOX Play Anywhere program works, head over to the official website.

The Resonance update is one of our biggest updates to date for Phasmophobia in terms of technicality and what it means for the game going forward. We’re excited to get it out to you and use it as a jumping off point for the next year’s worth of work, leading into Phasmophobia 1.0.

That said, there’s still more to come between now and then. To finish up, we wanted to share an update on our Player Character Visual Update as well as the next rework in line for release - 42 Edgefield Road.

Player Character Visual Update

Following on from our Player Character Update, we made the decision to add an extra update this year that focused on fleshing out the customisation and cosmetic side of Phasmophobia. With this we’ll be introducing over 30 new and unique cosmetics, each with their own colour and texture variants, improving the UI of the Customisation Shop and the character models themselves.

We had originally planned to ship this as part of the Resonance update, but we need to spend a bit more time on it to make sure it’s ready to make its way to you. Ultimately, we wanted to make sure Resonance is as solid and stable an update for everyone and this meant looking at each individual aspect and making the decision on what was ready, and what was not. 

We’ll share more details on when you can expect to see this update in Phasmophobia but in the meantime, we’re excited to share some screenshots of the upcoming cosmetics and UI rework as a preview.

42 Edgefield Road Rework

42 Edgefield Road is the next map in-line for a makeover, and our reworked version of it will be launching later this year. While we’ll share details on the rework closer to release, we wanted to leave you with a teaser in the form of the below screenshot.

Resonance will be launching for Phasmophobia next month, and we hope that the details we’ve shared in this Development Preview have you excited for its release. In the run up to the update, we encourage you to ask us questions via our social channels, our Discord server and Help Centre if you would like to know any more specifics about what we’ve talked about today. 

We’re excited to round out this year with really strong updates and believe it’ll put us in a good place heading into 2027 and beginning the road to 1.0 - which we’ll make sure you join us for every step of the way. 

Thank you, Ghost Hunters.

items.title: Ghost Hunts For Hearts Returns
items.summary: Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Today we’re excited to announce the return of Ghost Hunts for Hearts in collaboration with our good friends at American Heart Association Liive. Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000 for the
items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters. Today we’re excited to announce the return of Ghost Hunts for Hearts in collaboration with our good friends at American Heart Association Liive.

Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000 for the Heart Association's amazing cause and we’re hoping to go bigger and better this year by inviting the entire Phasmophobia community to join us.

We’re excited to share that we’re introducing a Twitch Drop as part of the campaign. From the get-go, any participating fundraising streamer will be able to distribute the event-exclusive Advocate ID Card & Badge throughout the week via any Phasmophobia stream.

We’re inviting any streamer that would like to take part in Ghost Hunts for Hearts via this link. Once registered, the Heart Liive team will be in contact to make sure you have everything you need to host your streams during the week of October 26th - November 2nd.

As an added bonus, if we reach our secret fundraising goal (which will be unveiled on the 26th), we’ll unlock the Animated version of this set for all players. Stay tuned for more details on the Drop as we get closer to event week!

You can find out more about American Heart Association Liive and the work they do by joining their Discord here.

We’re looking forward to seeing plenty of Ghost Hunts for Hearts at the end of the month!

items.content:
Once more, Ghost Hunters, we pay homage to the Blood Moon. Our dear Crimson Eye.

Today, we’re excited to reveal that this year’s Crimson Eye event will begin on October 8th, 2026, and run until November 1st, 2026. An update containing the event will be deployed on October 6th.

As with previous years’ events, the Crimson Eye will cast its presence across several locations in Phasmophobia. Playing on these locations will grant each player event points, working towards unlocking the Community and Personal rewards, details of which are below.

The following list of locations will be featured throughout the event:

  • 6 Tanglewood Drive

    [/*]

  • 42 Edgefield Road

    [/*]

  • Grafton Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • 13 Willow Street

    [/*]

  • Bleasdale Farmhouse

    [/*]

  • Point Hope (Standard only, Point Hope Restricted will not be included)

    [/*]

  • Camp Woodwind

    [/*]

  • Nell’s Diner

    [/*]

For those of you who have taken part in previous Crimson Eye events, you’ll know what to expect, but you’ll also get to see how Nell’s Diner and the reworked 6 Tanglewood Drive & 13 Willow Street look dressed in red. For newer Ghost Hunters, you’ll be tasked with hunting down Blood Moon totems and completing investigations and optional objectives to earn points, all while under the threat of Blood Moon weather, increasing the challenge you’ll face from ghosts.

Players will have several different unlockable rewards during the event: a seasonal event tee, the Beholder ID Card & Badge set and the Blood Moon charm.

Alongside these will be the upgradeable trophy. If you have previously unlocked this, you’ll continue to earn points and upgrades to your existing Trophy, rather than a new one.

During the event, we have a few different plans in place, so please do read on to learn what’s in store throughout October.

Twitch Drop

During the first week of Crimson Eye, a Twitch Drop campaign will be running for all Phasmophobia streamers. After watching a total of two hours of Phasmophobia streams, you’ll earn the Crimson Eye tee. The campaign will be live from the moment the event begins until 11:59 PM BST on October 15th, 2026.

Double XP & Rewards

As is becoming tradition with Phasmophobia’s seasonal events, we’ll be running a Double XP & Rewards event during Crimson Eye. This will be taking place between October 15th–22nd, with all rewards from completed investigations being doubled during this period. Mark your calendars, Ghost Hunters!

Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with the American Heart Association

Finally, during the final week of Crimson Eye (October 26th–November 1st), we’ll be bringing back Ghost Hunts 4 Hearts with our friends over at the American Heart Association! Last year, the Phasmophobia community raised over $100,000, which was an incredible achievement and went a long way towards helping the AHA team with their important work.

This year, we’re planning to go bigger and better; this event, and its rewards, will be accessible to all Phasmophobia creators & players when it goes live. While we’ll share details nearer the time, we just wanted to get the dates in your calendars!

We look forward to celebrating our favourite season with you once again, Ghost Hunters.

Our next update following this will be our transition to Unity 6. This will be releasing in November, which is just a little shift from our original aim of October. We’ll be talking in more detail about this update as well as our cosmetics update in an upcoming Development Preview. Rest assured, our Crimson Eye event is still scheduled for October. items.content:
Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Thank you to everyone for the warm reception to our first Quality of Life update last month, and we’re glad to see many of you enjoying Phasmophobia once more.

Today as promised, we’re sharing details on the upcoming second Quality of Life update for Phasmophobia. We’ll be releasing this update across all platforms on 25th August, 2026. Exact release times are still to be confirmed, so keep an eye on our channels for official confirmation of when the update is live. 

Let’s break down a couple of the features we’re excited about before sharing the full list: 

New Restricted Options

For a long while, we have seen folks requesting smaller versions of our larger maps in the vein of Sunny Meadows Restricted. With this update we’re excited to introduce Restricted versions for Prison, Brownstone High School and Point Hope.

As with Sunny Meadows, these map variants are designed for quicker games in locations that we know players enjoy but sometimes don’t want to be investigating the larger area. In the case of Point Hope Restricted, which will be classed as small, Ghost Hunters will be able to access up to the Dining Room while Prison and Brownstone High School will have multiple variants - classed as Small and Medium respectively - which will be randomly assigned upon loading into a contract. 

Brownstone High School in particular will have a total of 4 map variants following the update. With such a big map, we believed it was appropriate to give a variety of variations, giving Ghost Hunters a sense of mystery when loading up. Outside each Restricted version of the map, a small piece of environmental decor will signify which variant of the map you’re on.

Journal & Evidence Changes

We made a handful of changes and improvements to Evidence collection with the first Quality of Life update, and we’re doing the same with the second. As with all of our updates, we’ll be looking for and reading through player feedback on these changes so please do let us know your thoughts once you’ve spent some time with them. 

Since our Chronicle update last year, we’ve been working on finessing the Unique/Duplicate system. A change we’re introducing with this next update means there’ll now be visual indicators to show that a piece of Media a Ghost Hunter captures is a Duplicate without the need to check the Journal. 

To detect a Duplicate, keep an eye out for the following indicators:

  • Tier 1 Photo Cameras will display a yellow LED light.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Photo Cameras and all Tiers of Video Cameras will display a faded overlay, rather than the usual bold white text.

    [/*]

  • Tier 1 Sound Recorder will lower the brightness of the Volume indicators.

    [/*]

  • Tier 2 & 3 Sound Recorders will display faded sound waves.

    [/*]

Another important addition in this update is being able to see other Ghost Hunters’ Evidence and Ghost selections in the Journal. This means there’ll be no more need to double check with other players which pieces of Evidence you’ve captured and see other’s opinions on which Ghost the group is dealing with - and of course making sure everyone has the same selection when you’re leaving in the Truck!

Elsewhere, we’ve replaced the Keys section in the journal with the ‘Items We’ve Found’ section. Appearing in the order they are found, this will display collected items such as keys, the bone and seasonal event collectables. On this same page, a gender symbol (♀/♂) will now be displayed alongside the Ghost's name, allowing for easier understanding of male and female names and Ghost types - especially for non-English speaking players.

VR Improvements

With this Quality of Life update, we’re completely replacing the VR character rig across all platforms. This means more responsive movement in-line with your own body’s, improved accuracy on the character model to match player’s arm length as well as an overall improvement to visuals of the character model when playing with VR users.

We’re also addressing several regularly reported issues from VR players, which we’ll detail in the full patch notes at release. As with other areas of Phasmophobia, please do let us know any feedback you have from your time in VR or any issues you encounter via our Help Centre.

Gameplay Improvements

Finally, for today, we just wanted to dive in to some of the changes coming to the gameplay of Phasmophobia. Firstly, we’ll be implementing the ability to select the Ghost Type for any Custom Difficulty investigations. You’ll find this in the Ghost settings when setting up your game, as you can see in the screenshot below.

Another change with this update is a change to character appearance upon death. As seen below, the dead body will now be seen with a greyer skin as well as misty eyes. Dead players will also appear this way to others while Dead. In addition to this change a player’s voice chat will now be cut off as soon as they die - the moment their neck is snapped during the death animation.

Below, you’ll find a list of all the New features coming with this Quality of Life update as well as the Changes section. At the release of the update, as mentioned, we’ll share the full patch notes along with the list of Fixes for known bugs and issues. We look forward to sharing this update with you on August 25th, 2026.

items.title: Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Has Been Relaunched
items.summary: Phasmophobia: The Board Game has officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition for purchase, after being sold out at launch last October.
items.content:
Posted in: Board Games , Games , Tabletop | Tagged: Kinetic Games , Lost In Cult

Phasmophobia: The Board Game has officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition for purchase, after being sold out at launch last October.

Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have officially relaunched the Deluxe Edition of Phasmophobia: The Board Game since orders first launched back in October 2025. The board game originally went up for pre-order last year, and fans wanted to get their hands on the Deluxe Edition so much that it sold out faster than the main tabletop title. Now they have opened the shop back up for this version as they're making more units to purchase. We have more info on the game itself here, as its being sold for about $162. If you can't get it, that's okay; the normal version is selling now for the same price.

An eerie chill sweeps through your home. Grabbing your flashlight & Spirit Box, you descend the basement steps with trepidation. "Are you here?" you call out meekly. Your torch beam scans the room, lingering on the dusty Ouija board left on the floor in disrepair. Its planchette begins to move. "Y". Your eyes widen. "E". Your heart lurches. "S"…

Welcome, Ghost Hunters, to the paranormal world of Phasmophobia: The Board Game . Assemble your team of 1-4 players and explore iconic homes, or even build your own! An unknown ghost torments you within – commune with this spectral entity, discover evidence of its existence, and escape with your sanity intact, if you can…

Developed in official collaboration with Kinetic Games and created by Lost In Cult, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the chilling terror of the video game to life. Equip your team with iconic gear and cursed possessions as you investigate the haunted property; this chilling adaptation plunges you into a world of suspense and survival. The terror has crossed over to your tabletop — will you rise to the challenge, or unravel when darkness closes in?

With design from Lost In Cult and artwork from illustrator Jamie Flack , the game's meticulously-realized maps depict iconic properties from the video game with authenticity and careful attention to detail. Joined by carefully-crafted key items and tokens, all is entombed inside a reveal box guaranteed to turn heads and earn pride of place on your shelf.

items.title: Pre-Orders Return for the Deluxe Edition of ‘Phasmophobia: The Board Game’
Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition Returns for a Limited Time
items.summary: Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the Phasmophobia: The Board Game Deluxe Edition ahead of its expected Q4 2026 release.
items.content:
Lost In Cult and Kinetic Games have reopened limited pre-orders for the collector’s edition after the original run sold out shortly after it launched in October 2025.

Based on Kinetic Games’ hit cooperative horror game, Phasmophobia: The Board Game brings the ghost-hunting experience to the tabletop for one to four players. Investigators will search haunted locations, gather evidence, identify one of 24 different ghost types, and try to keep their sanity intact as increasingly unsettling paranormal events unfold.

The standard game includes investigator cards, themed dice, a Ghost Behaviour Board, more than 50 Hallucination cards, and everything needed to recreate the tense cooperative gameplay that made the video game a phenomenon.

Collectors looking for something extra may want to move quickly. The Deluxe Edition once again includes several exclusive items, including a digitally signed edition from the Kinetic Games team, a behind-the-scenes hardcover book, a secret film strip, Polaroid memorabilia, and a premium presentation box. It also features glow-in-the-dark components, metallic tarot cards, upgraded dice, and other cosmetic enhancements designed specifically for dedicated fans.

Lost In Cult says production on the board game continues, with the first shipments currently expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

Given how quickly the Deluxe Edition disappeared during its initial release, interested players may not want to wait too long before securing a copy this time around.

Preorder a copy here https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/phas-std-sy5y5
